title: Nine Pages of Promise
subtitle: 宣传册与手册 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 宣传册与手册（社会服务与人际沟通·信息与服务）
meta: 主题语境：宣传册与手册（社会服务与人际沟通·信息与服务）　|　核心词汇：brochure　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 brochure 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 my mother was sent to print ① a brochure she could not read, and she said the reading was the whole of the lesson. The ② brochure, meaning the leaflet and not the journey, was nine pages long and was taken by whoever came last; a brochure, she said, is the only thing in a rack that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ brochure in that rack had the same cover, and the ④ brochure at the front, meaning the one the clerk kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever folded properly. A brochure, my grandmother said, is nine parts promise and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the promise is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ brochure was the whole of the trip, meaning the journey it promised and not the leaflet. The ⑥ brochure, meaning the trip and not any of that, is the only thing in a station that everybody takes and nobody questions; a brochure, he said, is either something you print or the only word that means both a leaflet and a trip. She said the trip is the part they remember.

By 1977 the ⑦ brochure had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the cover. The ⑧ brochure of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine pages and eleven years of printing; a brochure, she said, is either the one at the front or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ brochure I remember is the one at the front, which was reprinted in 1982 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ brochure, my grandmother said in 1985, is the only thing that improves by being read; every brochure, she said, is a trip that has agreed to look like a leaflet. She said the trip was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 小册子；宣传册
B. n. 宣传册（指那张纸本身，与旅程相对）
C. 固定搭配：print a brochure 印一份宣传册
D. n. 宣传册（指架子上每一份）
E. n. 宣传册（指前面那一份）
F. n. 宣传册（抽象：它所许诺的那趟旅程）
G. n. 那趟旅程（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a brochure she could not read
The brochure, meaning the leaflet and not the journey
brochure was the whole of the trip
the brochure had become a photograph in a report
The brochure of the whole thing
A brochure, my grandmother said in 1985

answers.why: print a brochure 意为“印一份宣传册”，1963 年母亲被派去印一份她读不懂的宣传册。
brochure 意为“宣传册”，指那张纸本身而不是旅程，共九页，由最后走的人拿走。
brochure 指架子上每一份宣传册，每一份都是同样的封面。
brochure 指前面那一份（店员留的那一份），是唯一有人认真折好的。
brochure 意为“宣传册”，抽象指它所许诺的那趟旅程，父亲说 brochure 就是那趟旅行的全部。
brochure 为抽象用法，指那趟旅程本身，是车站里人人都拿、却没人质疑的东西。
brochure 意为“小册子、宣传册”，到 1977 年这份 brochure 成了报告里的一张照片。
brochure 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九页纸和十一年的印刷。
brochure 意为“宣传册”，我记得的是前面那一份，1982 年重印，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
brochure 为抽象总称，祖母说宣传册是唯一会因为被认真读过而变好的东西。
